condition_aliases._note: Patient condition names (lower case) -> MED-RT disease names. MED-RT 'ci_with' links are coarse (e.g. heart failure is listed for beta-blockers that treat it), so every MED-RT match is reported as a 'caution - check the label for the specific circumstance', never as a blocking contraindication. Only label-quoted curated edges can block.
